1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
2. Despite mention slip being given to the learned counsel for opposite party no.2, no one has appeared on behalf of opposite party no.2.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants is permitted to make necessary correction the prayer clause of this application during the course of the day.

4. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing summoning order dated 18.02.2016 as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.1231 of 2015 (Suman Devi Vs.
Praveen Kumar & others), under Sections 498-A, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act against applicant nos.1 and 2 and under Section 498A IPC against applicant nos.3 and 4, P.S. Baragaon,
District Varanasi, pending in the court of A.C.J.M., Court No.5, Varanasi.

Complaint Case No.1231 of 2015 (Suman Devi Vs.
Praveen Kumar & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. The instant application filed on behalf of applicant nos.1 and 2 has already been dismissed by this Court vide order dated 11.04.2016 and the same survives only for applicant nos. 3 and 4.
6.

As per the allegations made in the complaint, it is alleged that opposite party no. 2 was married to applicant no. 1 on 29.05.2014, however, after the said marriage, the applicants started demanding additional dowry and for non-fulfilment of demand of additional dowry, they started torturing and maltreating her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out of her matrimonial home.

7. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the complaint and the material collected during the course of enquiry, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purposes of harassment.
He has pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention.

8. Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that applicant no.3 is the brother-in-law and applicant no.4 is the sister-in-law of opposite party no.2 and no specific allegation has been made against them rather general and vague allegations, just to drag them in criminal court has been alleged.
As a matter of fact, they have no concern whatsoever with the day to day affairs between husband and wife and have been falsely roped in only on account of being the family members of her husband.

9. Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the complaint and the material collected during the course of enquiry, prima facie offence is clearly made out against applicants.

10. From the material collected during the course of enquiry also, it is evident that general, vague and omnibus allegations have been made against applicant no. 3, brother-in-law and applicant no.4,
sister-in-law of opposite party no.2 and as such, it would be unjust if they are forced to go through tribulations of a trial, that is, general, vague and omnibus allegations cannot be manifest in a situation, where the relatives of the victim's husband are forced to undergo trial in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in varied instances, that a criminal trial leading to an eventual acquittal also inflicts severe scars upon the accused, and such an exercise must therefore be discouraged.

11. In view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Taramani Parak Vs. State of M.P. and Others, (2015) 11 SCC 260, Geeta Mehrotra and Another Vs. State of U.P. and Another,
(2012) 10 SCC 741, Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonal Vs. State of Bihar (2022) 6 SCC 599 and Abhishek Vs. State of M.P., Criminal Appeal No. 1456 of 2023, the aforesaid proceedings in respect of Praveen Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119413925/
2 applicant nos.3 and 4 are quashed.
